mcqs.q: Is the result of 6 / 0.5 larger or smaller than 6?
options: Equal to 6, because 0.5 is half and so cancels out.
P(A | B) is always P(A) + P(B).
Larger — dividing by a number less than 1 gives a bigger result (6 / 0.5 = 12).
Smaller, because division always makes numbers smaller.

mcqs.q: Is P(A | B) the same as P(B | A)?
options: P(A | B) is always P(A) + P(B).
P(A | B) = P(B | A) because conditioning is symmetric.
Generally no — these conditional probabilities are different unless P(A) = P(B).
